decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the firm's established textile and interior offer, still has its own page in 2024, and the firm's design and material know-how lets it interpret results and refine the product.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's craftsmanship and fine-material expertise and keeps a dedicated page, so the firm can learn from its results and keep it in the collection.

The corner bench builds on the firm's established seating competence and was still promoted as a new interpretation in 2024, though moving from a dedicated page to a mention signals somewhat weaker visibility.
The low-pile carpet is close to existing knowledge and still has its own page, but a sibling carpet (C) has already been removed, which suggests the firm prunes its carpet range and adds some risk.
The swivel shell chair lies at the core of the firm's furniture and designer-collaboration knowledge and remains on its own page, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and keep developing it.
